response.justification: Bogdan is a skilled software engineer who meets minimum educational requirements (Bachelor's + 14+ years experience) and demonstrates strong performance optimization capabilities. However, this Principal-level role requires deep expertise in hardware architecture—specifically SoC/IP modeling, GPU design, and deep neural network workload optimization—where the candidate has no demonstrated experience. His background is primarily in application-level software development, not the hardware/chip architecture specialization essential for this position.
strengths: Meets educational requirement: Bachelor's degree in CS plus 14+ years of professional engineering experience
Proven ability to optimize performance-critical systems handling millions of operations per second with low-latency requirements
Diverse technical foundation including lower-level languages (C, C++, DLang) and distributed systems architecture knowledge
concerns: No semiconductor design, SoC modeling, or IP architecture experience—core technical responsibilities of the role
AI-agent infrastructure experience appears focused on frameworks/orchestration rather than hardware accelerator optimization for deep learning
Lacks GPU architecture knowledge, SIMD/MIMD architecture experience, and deep neural network training/inference optimization expertise

key_factors.factor: No deep neural network workload optimization background
Strong performance optimization and systems-level experience
